Setup.Name: Usage of variables
Setup.Description: Defines a variable at a subscription and then uses this variable in an attribute.
Setup.Manifest:
Version: 1.0

MqttConnections:
  - Name: "My broker"

OtelConnections:
  - Name: "My Otel server"
    ServiceName: "my-service"
    ServiceNamespace: "my-service-namespace"

Processors:
  - Name: "Sensor Temperature"
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Name: "Sensor temperature"
          Topic: "sensor/temperature"
          Variables:
             - Key: "SensorName"
               Value: "My sensor"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          SignalDataType: Float
          Instrument: Gauge
          Attributes:
            - Key: "sensor name"
              Value: "$SensorName"
          Value: "PAYLOAD()"
